programme.title: E5 - An Adventure, Pedals, Rescue & Stars!
programme.desc: Join the Minibods for an adventure with pedals, rescues & stars! Lulu goes camping but realizes she's left her favorite Binky Bunny behind & has to learn how to cope. Then, Newt goes on an adventure to find a real-life Flutterbug, but she has to be brave when her bike's stabilizers come off! The adventures continue as Jeff overcomes his fear of mud to rescue his feather duster & Bubbles builds a rocket to try & reach a big purple star in the sky!

programme.title: E2 - Mia & Max's Artsy August Picnic
programme.desc: Have an Artsy August picnic! Join Mia and Max for some messy painting, then put on a performance of Humpty Dumpty. Create a Dinosaur Cafe for snacks, learn about families, and play This Little Piggy after a fun day in the garden!

programme.title: E3 - Mia & The Bus's Art Day
programme.desc: Get arty with Little Baby Bum this August! Help Mia and her friends paint a huge mural of The Bus. Then, bake yummy muffins with Rose, play BINGO with the whole family, and have a dino-tastic snack time in a pretend Dinosaur Cafe!

programme.title: E2 - Construction Chaos & Clever Fixes
programme.desc: Get ready for some construction chaos & clever fixes! First, Mr. Rubble is very tired & puts the plans on the board upside down, causing the crew to build a house upside down! Then, while building a roundabout, the crew finds some big old dinosaur bones! The chaos continues as a power cut stops all their machines, so they hook everything up to clean solar panels instead. From building a pond for frogs to building themselves into a box, it's always chaotic!

programme.title: E10 - Baby John's Artsy August Day
programme.desc: Let's get baking this Artsy August! Follow a picture cookbook with Baby John and Manny to make muffins, but get ready for a mess! Then, celebrate Dia de los Muertos, build toy boats, and have a fun, paint-splattering race in the garden!

programme.title: E9 - Baby John's Art-omobile Race
programme.desc: Design the coolest wagon for Artsy August! Help Jack, Jill, and Baby John decorate their wagons with balloons and more for the big race. Then, play dress-up as pirates and astronauts, build a giant sandcastle, and pretend to be dinosaurs!

programme.title: E3 - Fun Nature Discoveries!
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun nature discoveries! First, he & D.BO dive to the ocean floor to help a forgetful island remember why it doesn't float away. Then, they shrink down for some smaller adventures! They help a firefly find a friend with the same blinking pattern, float high in the sky to learn how bubbles are made & join a group of ants on a mission to find out how they walk in such a straight line. The adventure is full of singing, science & new friends!

programme.title: E8 - Baby John's August Art Box
programme.desc: Get crafty for Artsy August! Dig into Baby John's craft box and make a whole family of finger puppets. Then, play a fun color-matching game with a new train, count magical potatoes, and have a bubbly, colorful bath time adventure!

programme.title: E4 - JJ & Nina's August Art-Beat!
programme.desc: Get your groove on for Artsy August! Dance along with colorful jello unicorns, dragons, and sea lions. Then, play a game of Red-Light Green-Light, do a silly animal dance, and join a beautiful ballet performance on a theatre stage!

programme.title: E4 - Blocks, Dancing, Football & Storytime!
programme.desc: It's a day of learning to play together with blocks, dancing, football & storytime! First, Jeff's neat block towers keep getting knocked over by Bubbles, & they must learn to share their space. Then, Fuse refuses to listen to instructions during a dancing game & has to learn how to work as a team. The lessons continue as Bubbles learns not to cheat to win a football game & Jeff has to decide if he will share his new book during storytime.

Plus, Fuse is craving a snack but can't get the box open & Pogo's ice cream keeps melting!

programme.title: E7
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: E29
programme.desc: 寧檬一直有一個成為投資總監的職業夢想，可畢業後做的工作卻與夢想相距甚遠。她的上司陸既明是一個業務能力極強的投資總裁，他不認為寧檬也能成為合格的投資人。某一天寧檬終於下定決心離開陸既明，向他也向自己證明她可以做到。寧檬重新求職，經過種種阻礙，機緣下最終進入了鷹石投資，開始了她的晉升之路。過程中陸既明也在關注着寧檬，起初他不認可，但在重要關頭還是會對寧檬進行提點，幫助她度過難關。陸既明長遠的投資理念使寧檬獲益匪淺，寧檬也改變了陸既明的處世態度。兩人互相影響，攜手並進，經歷了無數的波折和風浪之後，寧檬蜕變成為了獨當一面的金牌投資人，陸既明也歷練得更加成熟有擔當。他們認定彼此就是自己最正確的那個人。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 三位51歲、對人生感到失意的中年大叔——吉井雄太、藤卷肇與菊原紀介，因故鄉傳來「工地挖出人骨」的新聞而重聚。他們原是少年時代的電影研究部夥伴，卻在回憶往昔時，驚覺他們的女顧問老師竟被標註為「行方不明」。這個發現，點燃了他們追查老師神祕失蹤真相的決心，也開啟了一段重新檢視自我與青春的救贖之旅。

programme.title: E50
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: THE SHADOW'S EDGE
programme.desc: A crew of criminal prodigies disappears with billions, evading capture by outsmarting the formidable “Sky Eye” surveillance system. Desperate and outmaneuvered, the Macau police enlist the help of a legend-Wong Tak-Chung, a retired tracking expert. He mentors rookie officer He Qiuguo and rebuilds an elite surveillance unit. Their mission: to track down the elusive “Wolf King,” Fu Longsheng, the mastermind behind the heist. As the police close in, the thieves spring a trap of their own. Brains clash, loyalties are tested, and the ultimate cat-and-mouse game is about to begin...

programme.title: Keep Rolling
programme.desc: On a buzzing red carpet, a 70-year-old short-haired woman strides towards the stage with confidence. Behind the red carpet, it's a muddy path that leads to a movie studio in New Territories, Hong Kong. To her, glory and hardship are nothing more than just different paths that lead to the world of cinema. Born in Northeastern China, raised in Macau and educated in Hong Kong, Ann Hui stays true to her cultural heritage as a Chinese, yet she has always been fascinated by Western literature and therefore decided to further her studies in London. Eventually, she found movies. Through movies, she becomes fully immersed into the ‘East-meets-West' culture and lifestyle of Hong Kong; She reconciles with her distant mother; And she gets to explore the cultural and social identity of her and the city she calls home. Movies also found her. Having learned from veteran auteur King Hu, her directorial debut became part of the impetus behind Hong Kong's New Wave as she explores marginalize

programme.title: Mighty Baby
programme.desc: Lena, Johnny and Wayne are commissioned to expand a new line of business specializing in merchandise for infants named 'Mighty Baby'. Johnny, enjoying his new perks as a supervising executive, hires a neurotic secretary Sabrina. Knowing that her boyfriend Wayne is a 'baby-phobic', Lena seeks help from Boey, an expert in child behavioral patterns. Finally, Johnny and Wayne overcome a lot of obstacles to bring their 'What babies Want' product line to fruition......

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: When a visitor from beyond the stars – an impish and adorable alien called LU-LA – crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun soon sees an opportunity for alien-powered fun and adventure, and sets off on a mission to shepherd LU-LA back to her home... Little do the pair know, though, that they are being pursued at every turn by a mysterious alien-hunting government agency, spearheaded by the formidable Agent Red and her bunch of hapless, hazmat-suited goons. Can Shaun and the flock avert Farmageddon on Mossy Bottom Farm before it's too late?

programme.title: Spy Girls
programme.desc: Shih Tzu is a tough journalist; despite, being a tiny lady with 155cm height. All her life, she's been teased about being so tiny. So, she determines to have a tall boyfriend and when she gets married, she can have tall children. She even wishes to name her baby “Giraffe.” As soon as she meets Faifa, the tallest senior in her university, who becomes a dedicated and hardworking Police Officer, she determines to win his heart. Would she be able to excel in her career and make him fall in love with her?

programme.title: Why me, Sweetie?!
programme.desc: American Chinese Ding studies drama in Beijing. One day, she helps her friend chase after her boyfriend, running vigorously on a Beijing street where she bumps into Dong. The next day, Ding visits Dong, who, strangely enough, denies their acquaintance. Dong's buddy Dr Ching diagnoses his erratic behavior as the protection mechanism of human brain. The only way to lessen the pain is to erase or repress happy memories...
